deliberate on the matter: The committee needs a few more days to deliberate on the matter before making a final decision about the new school rules.
委員會需要再幾天審慎商議這件事，才能對新校規做出最後決定。
the jury deliberated: After hearing all the evidence, the jury deliberated for two full days before they finally reached a decision.
聽完所有證據後，陪審團審議了整整兩天，才終於做出決定。
a deliberate attempt: The broken window was not an accident; it was a deliberate attempt to get into the house at night.
那扇破窗不是意外，而是有人蓄意企圖在夜裡闖進屋內。
delight the audience: The young magician hoped to delight the audience with funny tricks, and soon everyone in the hall was laughing.
年輕的魔術師希望用有趣的把戲令觀眾開心，很快大廳裡每個人都在笑。
delight in teasing: My older brother seems to delight in teasing me about my bad singing whenever our relatives visit.
每當親戚來訪，我哥哥似乎就以逗弄我唱歌難聽為樂。
be delighted to hear: Grandma will be delighted to hear that you passed the exam, so please call her tonight.
奶奶聽到你考試及格一定會很高興，所以今晚請打電話給她。
deliver a speech: Our principal will deliver a speech at the graduation ceremony to encourage students to follow their dreams.
我們校長將在畢業典禮上發表演說，鼓勵學生追尋夢想。
deliver results: The new manager promised to deliver results within six months, and sales did rise quickly after that.
新經理承諾在六個月內交出成果，之後銷售額確實迅速上升。
deliver on a promise: Voters were angry because the mayor did not deliver on a promise to build a new park downtown.
選民很生氣，因為市長沒有兌現在市中心蓋新公園的承諾。
deliver a baby: The taxi driver had to help deliver a baby in the back seat because the hospital was still far away.
因為醫院還很遠，計程車司機只好在後座幫忙接生。
deliver a blow: The sudden typhoon managed to deliver a blow to local farmers just before the fruit was ready to pick.
這場突如其來的颱風在水果即將採收前，給了當地農民沉重的打擊。
deliver a verdict: The judge is expected to deliver a verdict tomorrow morning, and reporters are already waiting outside the court.
法官預計明天早上宣判，記者們已經在法院外等候。
demand an apology: After the waiter spilled soup on her dress, the angry customer decided to demand an apology from the manager.
服務生把湯灑在她洋裝上後，生氣的顧客決定要求經理道歉。
the job demands patience: Teaching young children is tiring, and the job demands patience because kids often ask the same question again and again.
教小孩很累，這份工作需要耐心，因為孩子常常一再問同樣的問題。
demand attention: Babies demand attention almost every hour, so new parents rarely get a full night of sleep.
嬰兒幾乎每小時都需要關注，所以新手父母很少能睡個好覺。
in high demand: Concert tickets for the famous band are in high demand, and they sold out within ten minutes.
那個知名樂團的演唱會門票需求很大，十分鐘內就賣光了。
demonstrate a skill: Each student must demonstrate a skill in front of the class, such as cooking, dancing, or playing an instrument.
每位學生都必須在全班面前展示一項技能，例如烹飪、跳舞或演奏樂器。
demonstrate against the war: Thousands of people gathered in the square to demonstrate against the war and called for peace.
數千人聚集在廣場上示威反戰，並呼籲和平。
demonstrate one's ability: The interview gave her a chance to demonstrate her ability to solve problems under pressure.
這次面試讓她有機會證明自己在壓力下解決問題的能力。
demonstrate how: Before we start the experiment, the teacher will demonstrate how to use the equipment safely.
在我們開始實驗前，老師會示範如何安全地使用器材。
depart from tradition: This year the family decided to depart from tradition and eat at a restaurant instead of cooking at home.
今年這家人決定背離傳統，到餐廳吃飯而不在家煮。
depart from the script: The actor often likes to depart from the script and make up funny lines that are not in the story.
那位演員常喜歡脫稿演出，即興說出劇本裡沒有的好笑台詞。
the train departs: Please hurry up because the train departs at 7:15, and the next one does not come until nine.
請快一點，因為火車七點十五分出發，下一班要到九點才來。
the dearly departed: During the festival, families burn incense and offer food to remember the dearly departed.
節日期間，家家戶戶燒香並供奉食物來紀念已故者。
depict life in the 1950s: The old black-and-white photos depict life in the 1950s, when few families in Taiwan owned a TV.
那些黑白老照片描繪了五〇年代的生活，當時台灣很少家庭擁有電視。
be depicted as a hero: In the new painting, the young firefighter is depicted as a hero carrying a child out of the fire.
在這幅新畫作中，年輕消防員被描繪成把孩子從火場抱出的英雄。
depict scenes: The beautiful paintings on the temple walls depict scenes from famous Chinese legends.
寺廟牆上美麗的壁畫描繪了中國著名傳說中的場景。
deploy troops: After the earthquake, the government decided to deploy troops to help rescue people trapped under buildings.
地震過後，政府決定部署軍隊協助救出受困在建築物下的民眾。
deploy resources: To fight the forest fire, the city had to deploy resources such as helicopters, trucks, and hundreds of workers.
為了撲滅森林大火，市政府必須調度直升機、卡車和數百名工作人員等資源。
deploy a new system: The bank plans to deploy a new system in all its branches next month so customers can wait less.
這家銀行計劃下個月在所有分行部署新系統，讓顧客等候時間縮短。
deploy arguments: In the debate, she was able to deploy arguments based on clear facts, which impressed the judges.
在辯論中，她能運用以明確事實為基礎的論點，令評審印象深刻。
